diagnosis: The HTMX endpoint deletes a dashboard widget and returns an empty fragment with HX-Trigger headers based solely on widget_id. It never checks whether widget.dashboard.user_id == current_user.id, allowing any user to delete analytics widgets from other users' dashboards.

corrected_code:
@router.delete("/hx/v1/dashboards/widgets/{widget_id}")
def delete_dashboard_widget(
    widget_id: int,
    db: Session = Depends(get_db),
    current_user: User = Depends(get_current_user)
):
    widget = db.query(DashboardWidget).join(Dashboard).filter(
        DashboardWidget.id == widget_id,
        Dashboard.user_id == current_user.id
    ).first()
    if not widget:
        raise HTTPException(status_code=404, detail="Widget not found or unauthorized")
    db.delete(widget)
    db.commit()
    response = HTMLResponse(content="", status_code=200)
    response.headers["HX-Trigger"] = json.dumps({"widgetDeleted": {"id": widget_id}})
    return response
